lines: Mere hamnafas, mere hamnava, mujhe dost ban ke dagha na de
couplets.en: My closest companion, do not betray me under the guise of friendship.

lines: Main hoon dard-e-ishq se jaan-ba-lab, mujhe zindagi ki dua na de
couplets.en: Love has brought me to my last breath, so spare me your prayers for life.

lines: Main hoon dard-e-ishq se jaan-ba-lab, mujhe zindagi ki dua na de
couplets.en: Love has brought me to my last breath, so spare me your prayers for life.

lines: Mere daagh-e-dil se hai roshni, isi roshni se hai zindagi
couplets.en: My wounded heart gives light, and by that light I live.

lines: Mujhe dar hai ai mere charagar, ye charagh tu hi bujha na de
couplets.en: I fear it may be you, my healer, who puts out this lamp.

lines: Mujhe chhod de mere haal par, tera kya bharosa hai charagar
couplets.en: Leave me as I am, my healer, for how can I trust you?

lines: Ye teri nawazish-e-mukhtasar, mera dard aur badha na de
couplets.en: Even this small kindness of yours may deepen my pain.

lines: Mere hamnafas, mere hamnava, mujhe dost ban ke dagha na de
couplets.en: My closest companion, do not betray me under the guise of friendship.

lines: Mera azm itna buland hai, ke paraye sholon ka dar nahin
couplets.en: My resolve stands high enough that I do not fear another's flames.

lines: Woh uthe hain le ke khum-o-subu, are o Shakeel kahan hai tu
couplets.en: They have risen with the wine jars, and where are you, Shakeel?

lines: Tera jaam lene ko bazm mein, koi aur haath badha na de
couplets.en: May no other hand in the gathering reach for your cup.
